input.quote: 10.2 Vendor shall deliver all completed and in-process Deliverables for which Customer has paid or agrees to pay the applicable proportionate Fees. Vendor shall refund prepaid recurring Fees covering the period after termination, together with Fees paid for Services Customer cannot reasonably use because of Vendor's uncured breach.
input.rationale: Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination) addresses only access cut-off after "any agreed transition period", Deliverable delivery and Fee refunds. There is no obligation on Vendor to provide transition/migration assistance, to return or export Customer Data in a usable format, or to delete and certify deletion. Section 16.5 expressly carves Customer Data out of the confidentiality return/destroy mechanic and defers it to "Sections 11 and 15" — but no Section 11 exists in the document and Section 15 covers processing limits and privacy only, not exit. Searches for data return/export/deletion language return nothing. This is a hosted-services agreement, so the absence fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus 30-day export). Proposed insertion of a new Section 10.3 matching the preferred position (up to 6 months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable return, certified deletion, with a routine-backup/legal-retention carve-out consistent with Section 16.5).

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for export all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit clause because the Agreement has no obligation for Vendor to return or export Customer Data or to help us migrate (Section 16.5 cross-refers to a Section 11 that does not exist). Our playbook position is up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter; we can work with 90 days of assistance if that suits your delivery model better.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 10.3 requiring transition assistance, Customer Data return in machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion.
